hard_rules: service is the only multi-owner orchestration boundary and applications depend on service only
each symbolic current selector resolves exactly once and is never refreshed during the operation
independent current stores are not claimed as one distributed atomic snapshot
no hidden retry rebase last-known-good or generation fallback
ReferenceView selection is exact from selected publication bindings or an exact guard
exact roots only and no search or natural-language resolution in E3-C
owner ports are narrow typed and expose no raw storage analyzer parser or mutable handles
acquisition follows the frozen global order and release follows the reverse order
no public success envelope before mandatory resource closure completes
close failure cannot be hidden in complete partial or truncated success
continuation reopens exact retained generations and never resolves current
continuation is advertised only after required retention receipts are admitted
wow-context owns maps skeletons packs renderers continuations and validation; service never reconstructs them
invalid artifact is an operation-level Invalid payload when validation completed and not an internal service failure
service status preserves partial truncation NotEvaluated conflicts omissions and budgets
service cannot broaden source privacy license confidence or authority
no model search cbm source execution filesystem network process editor client SQL plugin or background work
CLI stream exit path and terminal state never enter service semantic identity
missing implementations probes fixtures evaluations and checksums are blocking and never pass
no Cargo Rust source or CI during this documentation phase
